_generated_by: AI-generated with Claude Code (Anthropic), directed and reviewed by the Moonat team.
value: height_m above the reference sphere (1 unit = 1 m)
layout: each tile is tile_size x tile_size values, row-major, row 0 = top (north for cylindrical, lon 0 side for south polar); tile (tr, tc) holds rows tr*tile_size.. and cols tc*tile_size..; edge tiles are padded with nodata

levels.source: LOLA LDEM_16 (NASA PDS), 2 x 2 block mean

levels.equations: s = pole; k = 2R/(1 + s*uz); x = k*uy; y_up = -s*k*ux; row = row0 - y_up/scale_m; col = col0 + x/scale_m (u = unit vector in MOON_ME, R = 1737400 m)
levels.use_where: lat_deg <= -80 (fall back to global8 outside the grid)
levels.source: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M (NASA PDS), 2 x 2 block mean of the central 2600 x 2600 px

algorithm: moonat.terrain.horizon (docs/validation/terrain.md); use the finest level that covers each ray sample, step = level cell size, bilinear interpolation
